limits: OSM is the dated 2026-10-16 extract; local street representation may differ from the user's screenshot date.
Width is a configured visual estimate; raw width/lanes tags were not applied.
The pinned coordinate operation reports 2 m accuracy and omits the preferred OSTN15 grid; this is not a measured alignment error.
Terrain profiles do not establish surveyed road edges, carriageway engineering, bridges, or vertical design.
Six browser poses are candidate reproductions; a street label alone does not establish exact correspondence to a user screenshot.
The AOI remains selected_pending_coverage / not_checked; no completeness or approval finding is made.

overallFinding.classification: inconclusive for a product defect; source/representation limitation supported for steep estimated ribbons
overallFinding.summary: The investigation reproduces source-to-package coordinates and surface areas, then compares terrain crossfall beneath estimated widths. A steep local terrain crossfall is observable; it does not show that the road was engineered at that grade or that the centerline is horizontally wrong. User screenshot camera pose and exact segment correspondence are unavailable, and the registered map is generalized. No renderer or GIS correction is evidenced by this diagnostic alone.

footprintComparisonSemantics.float32AndSliverCaveat: The comparison reconstructs numeric X/Z triangles from roads.json; render-time Float32 conversion and tiny clipped boundary slivers may affect area at sub-millimetre scales. No threshold is applied.
footprintComparisonSemantics.publishedTriangleAreaSumM2: Sum of each indexed roads.json triangle's clipped area; overlap is counted once per triangle before union.
footprintComparisonSemantics.publishedUnionAreaM2: Area of the union of the clipped indexed roads.json triangles across display groups.
footprintComparisonSemantics.sourceGroupUnionAreaM2: Source-derived per-way ribbon union before display-group priority partitioning.
footprintComparisonSemantics.sourcePriorityVisibleAreaM2: Source-derived per-group visible area after priority partitioning.
footprintComparisonSemantics.sourcePublishedSymmetricDifferenceAreaM2: Area present in exactly one of the source-visible geometry and the published indexed-triangle union.
footprintComparisonSemantics.sourceVisibleAreaM2: Area of the AOI-clipped source-derived visible group polygons after vehicular > cycleway > path priority partitioning, unioned across groups.

candidateWindowSummaries.meshFootprintInterpretation: Published triangles were reconstructed from surfaceBatches verticesXZ and indices, clipped to this registered local window, and unioned.
